summary: M1 plans delivery for 10 May and allows cancellation until 1 May. M2 expects delivery on 12 May and reports that sales considers the old date obsolete. The delivery dates conflict; neither memo is established as authoritative. The referenced appendix was not supplied, so its contents are outside this summary's coverage.

M2: Old date obsolete according to sales

contradictions.resolution: Unresolved; M2 attributes obsolescence of the old date to sales, but source authority is not established.
